scientific_integrity: The claimed phase diagram follows from explicit density integrals and sample-path asymptotics. No computational enumeration is described as an infinite proof; prior min-characteristic function results are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Fully specified Pareto type-I law with known shape and unit lower endpoint only. Does not treat fitted parameters, power, explicit Gaussian eigenvalues or singular-window weak limits. The finite checker corroborates but does not prove all-real-parameter statements. Historical originality is subject to independent literature verification.
title: Sharp sample-path and mean thresholds for power-weighted Pareto min-characteristic discrepancies
